report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency; one 344ms outlier aligns with a 322ms order client call. No 5xx, no dependency errors, no pool exhaustion, no memory retention data. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause from the taxonomy; operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Order service server-side latency and error metrics to explain the 322ms client call
Dependency operation metrics for gateway (empty series) to rule out downstream latency
Postgres/redis latency and connection pool saturation metrics
Memory retention time series per service to assess leak hypothesis
